sourceChecks.text: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

wikipediaReadEvidence.title: Kiriath-Jearim
wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: History, line 141: Chronicles identifies Shobal (possibly a descendant of Caleb) as “father of Kiriath-Jearim” (1 Chronicles 2:50–53), possibly meaning town founder. This supports a relevant association while retaining uncertainty about genealogical interpretation.
wikipediaReadEvidence.supportJa: 記事は対象節とショバルを明示しますが、カレブとの系譜や「父」の意味には可能性としての表現を用いています。関連記事として示し、記事から断定できない点を注記します。
